utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can still help with the repair drive by sorting tools, carrying supplies, or jumping on the small fixes. Just tell me what’s left and I’ll slot in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules. Keep sorting the tools and bring me the small-fix kit, and I’ll take the loose hinge and rough patch first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it, I’ll sort the tools and bring the small-fix kit over now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning, Ira. I think we just need to keep an eye on that loose hinge and the rough patch by the gate.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I hear you. I’ll keep checking in and passing along any updates while you watch that hinge and patch by the gate.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira. I’ll keep an eye on the hinge and that rough patch, and if anything else turns up I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like the repair drive is all set for Saturday afternoon at the community hall, with sign-ups already open. I’m glad Gus can bring the toolbox too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday afternoon works for me, and the community hall is fine as long as we keep it around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, then I’ll plan to be there around pickup time too and help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good. I’ll keep it quiet and meet you after sunset at the side gate.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good. I’ll meet you by the side gate after sunset and keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good. I’ll keep it quiet and see you there after sunset.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Kira. Just point me to the loose hinge and the rough patch by the gate, and I’ll keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, you’re sure the hinge and patch are the only things I need to point out?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, just those two. Point them out and I’ll keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Bo. I can bring my toolbox by and help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks, Gus. Bring the toolbox by and I’ll keep you posted on what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Bo. I’ll bring the toolbox by and keep an eye out for the next fixes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: A few things are still left, and I’m keeping the word moving. I can help sort out who still needs a fix.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort out who still needs a fix too. Just point me at the next person.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. I’ve got the parts on hand and Gus has the toolbox, so I’m set unless anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep people posted if anything shifts at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. I’m set for now, so just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still only comfortable if someone confirms the parts and tools are on hand, and who’s picking up anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — I’ll make sure the parts and tools are confirmed, and I’ll check who’s picking up anything missing before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep Noah posted and let him know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I’ll wait for your update on where to use it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll keep Noah posted and let him know once I have the update.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help track down what’s still missing. Send me the list when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the spare tape and screws on hand, so we’re covered if anything’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that covers it for now. If anything else turns up, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess. What’s the exact list of repairs and tools you’ve got so far?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m hearing it’s mostly a handful of specific fixes, so I’m checking around for the exact jobs and which tools match them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. Let me know once you have the exact list, and I’ll match the donated tools to each repair.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep the repair drive moving and let Noah know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, Vik. Keep me posted if you need anything else from my side.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep the repair drive moving and keep Noah in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning, Noah. I think it’s still just that loose hinge and the rough patch by the gate that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, that sounds about right. I’ll keep an ear out in case Vik says anything else.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning, Noah. I’ll keep checking on that hinge and the rough patch by the gate.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I can help spread the word and check who still needs a fix.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Bo. I’ll take care of the repair drive—just let me know who still needs a fix and I’ll handle the problem spots.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I’ll keep asking around and send you any spots that still need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. Can you list the exact repairs that still need doing so I can match each donated tool to the right job?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly the small fixes: donated tools should go to things like loose hinges, squeaky doors, patching, and simple repairs, plus sorting and carrying supplies so the right tools end up with the right jobs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s the latest I heard too: sign-ups are open, and it’s at the community hall Saturday afternoon. If you hear of any extra hands or tools, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. I’ll ask around for extra tools and hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Morning, Opal. I’ve got the plan in hand, and with Cleo’s supplies we should be set to finish the gate, hinge, and patch.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, sounds like the repair drive is on track. I’ll point anyone who needs it to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal. I’ll keep everyone pointed to the community center and make sure the gate work stays on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the spare tape and screws on hand, so we’re covered if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, then we’re set. Point me to the gate or the rough patch, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll point you to the gate, and if we find a rough patch I’ve got tape and screws ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara. I’ll bring my toolbox by and help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Gus. I’ve got your toolbox on the list, and I’ll keep the repair drive updated as things come in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara. I’ll bring the toolbox by and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive is still set for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Perfect, Rosa. I’ll keep it quiet and see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve got the tape, screws, and ladder ready, so we should be covered. Do you still need anything else for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That should cover it. I’m in if the parts and tools are all set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, then we’re set on my side too. I’ll keep an eye on the hinge and patch once we get started.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up today. If you need a hand, I can pass the word around.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I can help, but I’d like confirmation on the exact times before I commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, I’ll ask around and get the exact times before anyone commits.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep checking in and passing along anything else I hear before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira. Send them along when you can, and I’ll keep matching the drive to the school times.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Faye — I’ll keep sending anything I hear so you can line it up with the school times.
